instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully integrated, gorgeous academic workspace matching Track D requirements: Multimodal Knowledge Base ingestion (PDF, slides, lecture videos with timestamp extraction & diagram figures), Source-Grounded Q&A chat with exact citations and off-material flags, Adaptive Assessments (MCQ, short answer, numerical, repetition avoidance, cited feedback, weakness reports), Learner Model with per-topic mastery updates, System Evaluation Dashboard (faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall, simulated profiles), and Study Planning / Prerequisite Course Flow Map. Use warm paper tones (#FDFBF7, terracotta #8C4A32, forest #3D5A45, warm beige #F7F3E9). All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines: Never use pure black or pure white; always tint with warm undertones.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use generous spacing (p-8, p-12) and asymmetry in bento grids.
Always provide visible desktop navigation and clear state indicators.
Never use AI assistant emojis like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
